objective: Validate safe operator task branching, base/result commit tracking, and controller-review handoff without touching Rhino.
instructions: From local main, run ./exchange.sh and confirm this request is discovered from GitHub.
Run ./exchange.sh prepare bridge-phase3-001. It must create operator/bridge-phase3-001 from origin/main and must not modify main.

Measure the local state and create .bridge/state/operator-v03.json containing protocol_version, operator, repository, local_path, platform, branch, base_commit, remote_url, git_available, gh_available, codex_available, and checked_at. Do not invent values.
Commit .bridge/state/operator-v03.json as the task work commit. Capture that 40-character commit SHA as RESULT_COMMIT.

Create .bridge/reports/bridge-phase3-001.json following the v0.3 report template. Set base_commit to the exact commit printed by exchange.sh prepare. Set result_commit to RESULT_COMMIT. Set branch to operator/bridge-phase3-001. Set ack exactly to BRIDGE-V03-20260924-6B4D92-OPERATOR-ACK.
Run python3 .bridge/bridge_cli.py verify-report bridge-phase3-001 and require REPORT_OK before continuing.
Commit the report as a second receipt commit after the work commit.
Push operator/bridge-phase3-001 to origin. Do not merge it to main and do not push task changes directly to main.
Return a concise summary with branch name, base commit, result commit, receipt commit, and push status.
expected_outputs: A work commit referenced by result_commit
A later receipt commit containing the report
constraints: Do not test Rhino or modify rhino-cad-mcp.
Do not discard or overwrite local work.
Do not merge the operator branch.
Do not change bridge architecture unless a concrete bug blocks the test; if blocked, report the exact evidence.
